title: Area 51 workers sickened by burning hazardous waste; government denies buildings in court

tellings.quote: And one guy had to take pictures of it from the highway and said, "I used to work there." He had to tell a federal judge, "See this all these buildings in the distance in the desert? I used to work there." And the government attorneys denied seeing any buildings in the pictures.

plain: A scientist named John Brandenburg says workers at Area 51, the secret Nevada test site, got sick from hazardous waste being burned there and went to court. He says one man had to photograph the site from the highway and show a federal judge the buildings where he had worked, and the government's lawyers denied seeing any buildings in the pictures. He tells it to show how far the government would go to deny the base exists.
